_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Uko na mchezo wa Golf (Mchezo wa Karata) - Mchezaji {player_id}.
Lengo: Pata alama ya chini kabisa katika mzunguko huu mmoja. Ikiwa safu wana thamani sawa, wanajumuishwa kama 0.
Thamani za Karata: A=1, 2-10=thamani ya uso, J/Q=10, K=0

Vitendo (tumia mabano sahihi):
- '[draw]' - Chora kutoka kwenye sitaha
- '[take]' - Chukua kutoka kwenye kichupo cha taka
- '[swap X Y]' - Badilisha karata iliyochorwa na nafasi X (safu) Y (safu wima)
- '[discard]' - Tupa karata iliyochorwa

board.drew:
Ulichora: {card}
Sasa lazima u[swap X Y] au [discard] iyo.
board.took:
Ulichukua: {card} kutoka kwenye kichupo cha taka
Lazima u[swap X Y] nayo (huwezi kutupa).

options.final_turns: Mizunguko ya mwisho! Chaguo zako: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Ni lazima u: [swap X Y] (hutaweza kuacha maketi kutoka kwa kikundi cha maketi ya kuachwa)

message.deck_empty: Sitaha ya kadi imekwisha! Mchezo unamalizika mara moja.
message.knocked: MŨTALA {pid} nũkwĩkwa! Kĩla mũvĩla wingĩvaa ĩngĩ.
message.final_round: Mchezaji {pid} {reason}! Kila mchezaji mwingine anapata zamu moja zaidi.

invalid.wrong_action: Tumia kitendo kimoja tu kilichowekwa mabano: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], au [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Lazima kwanza u[draw], [take], [knock], au [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Hutaweza kuacha kete iliyochukuliwa kutoka kwa kikundi cha maketi ya kuachwa. Ni lazima uibadilishe.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Una karata iliyochorwa. Lazima u[swap X Y] au [discard] iyo.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Nafasi nje ya mipaka. Tumia safu 1-{max_row}, safu wima 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Huwezi kugonga na kadi iliyochorwa. Maliza zamu yako kwanza.
